headline: Record revenue and profit on AI memory demand

drivers.explanation: Growth led by Semiconductor Test ($1,122M of $1,329M total), including record Memory revenue on continued DRAM strength and a NAND final-test resurgence; Product Test $107M, Robotics $100M.
EPS growth (+385.7% y/y) roughly tracks net income growth (+377.9% y/y), with a slightly smaller diluted share count (157.7M vs 160.1M a year ago) from buybacks.
Excludes acquired intangible-asset amortization ($5.0M), restructuring and other ($3.0M), and ERP-related expenses ($2.5M), per the release's GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation table.

Operating expenses rose to $356.8M (from $307.9M in Q1'26 — higher selling/admin, R&D and acquired-intangible amortization) faster than the $46.5M q/q revenue gain, compressing operating margin to 32.9% from 36.9%.
Net income growth (+377.9% y/y) trails operating income growth (+382.5% y/y) on a higher effective tax rate (15.1% vs 12.7% a year ago) applied to the pretax income gain.
Tracks the same q/q dynamic as operating income: operating-expense growth outpaced the sequential revenue gain.
Cash rose q/q as $469.1M of operating inflows exceeded $271.3M of investing outflows (including a $165.6M acquisition) and $90.7M of financing outflows (including $68.7M buybacks, $20.3M dividends).

Increase reflects retained net income ($374.5M) net of buybacks (-$68.7M) and dividends (-$20.3M), partly offset by other equity items (stock comp, FX, an acquisition's minority interest) not itemized in the release.

CEO Greg Smith cited a strategy "to capture test and robotics opportunities from wafer to AI data center," pointing to year-on-year market expansion across all three business groups and "robust AI-related demand" behind the raised Q3 outlook.

summary_short: Teradyne's Q2 2026 revenue rose 103.9% y/y (+3.6% q/q) to $1,329.0M, a second consecutive quarterly record, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.38 (+385.7% y/y) and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $2.47 (+333.3% y/y), driven by record Memory-segment revenue on DRAM strength and a NAND final-test resurgence.
summary_long: Revenue rose 103.9% y/y and 3.6% q/q to $1,329.0M — a second straight quarterly record — led by Semiconductor Test ($1,122M, including record Memory revenue on DRAM strength and a NAND final-test resurgence), Product Test ($107M) and Robotics ($100M). Gross margin expanded y/y (57.2%→59.8%) but slipped q/q (60.9%→59.8%) as operating expenses ($356.8M, +16% q/q) outgrew revenue, compressing operating margin to 32.9% from 36.9% in Q1. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.38 (+385.7% y/y, -5.9% q/q); non-GAAP EPS was $2.47. Cash rose to $349.5M (+44.5% q/q) after $469.1M of operating cash flow, a $165.6M acquisition, $68.7M of buybacks and $20.3M of dividends. Teradyne guided Q3 2026 revenue to $1,200-1,300M — below Q2's print — with non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.85-$2.15.
